en.title: Fed Pause Boosts Israel Rate Hold
en.summary: The probability of the Bank of Israel making no change to its interest rate in July rose to 16% (+6.5%). This movement was primarily driven by the US Federal Reserve's decision on June 17 to leave its benchmark rate unchanged under new chair Kevin Warsh.
drivers: US Fed left benchmark rate unchanged June 17
New Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's emphasis on inflation
Potential signal of global central bank pause
en.why_matters: Central bank interest rate decisions significantly impact borrowing costs, inflation, and economic growth, affecting businesses and consumers alike. This market reflects expectations for Israel's monetary policy.
en.bull_case: Continued global central bank pauses, like the recent Fed decision, reduce pressure on the Bank of Israel to hike.
en.bear_case: Persistent domestic inflation or a stronger shekel could still compel the Bank of Israel to implement a rate hike.

zh.title: 美联储暂停加息提振以色列利率维稳
zh.summary: 以色列央行7月维持利率不变的概率升至16%（+6.5%）。这一变化主要受美国联邦储备委员会在新任主席凯文·沃什领导下，于6月17日决定维持基准利率不变的驱动。
drivers: 美联储6月17日维持基准利率不变
新任美联储主席凯文·沃什强调通胀
全球央行可能暂停加息的信号
zh.why_matters: 央行利率决策对借贷成本、通货膨胀和经济增长有重大影响，直接关系到企业和消费者。该市场反映了对以色列货币政策的预期。
zh.bull_case: 全球央行持续暂停加息，如美联储近期决定，减轻了以色列央行的加息压力。
zh.bear_case: 若国内通胀持续高企或谢克尔走强，以色列央行仍可能被迫加息。
